memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: reports independent driving, manages deliveries, no difficulty with ADLs. cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (recall 3, clock draw normal), negative screen. falls: 0 falls in last 12 months, gait steady, TUG 9 seconds, fall risk low. medicines: 0 regular, will start therapy. mood: denies anxiety, reports occasional worry about work, GAD-7 to be done. carers: lives alone, no formal carer. goals: "I want to stay healthy and keep working without medication side‑effects."

memories.text: function: continues driving, reports mild fatigue after long shifts. cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5, stable. falls: 0 falls, gait slightly slower on uneven ground, TUG 11 seconds, still <12, low risk. medicines: 6 regular (vit D, cetirizine, fluticasone, montelukast, escitalopram, buspirone) – polypharmacy, review against Beers advised. mood: GAD‑7 8 (mild anxiety), reports occasional tension. carers: lives alone, daughter calls weekly. goals: "I want to feel less tired and keep my job without drowsiness."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Refer to ENT for persistent allergic rhinitis despite intranasal steroid and antihistamine; consider allergen immunotherapy evaluation.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: ENT reviewed: allergic rhinitis confirmed, skin prick test positive to dust mites. Recommended continue cetirizine, fluticasone, montelukast; offered subcutaneous immunotherapy, patient declined due to travel. No further action needed.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Via app: Feeling more anxious lately, heart racing during night shifts, trouble sleeping despite buspirone. Request review of anxiety meds.

cetirizine 10 mg HS

cholecalciferol 2000 IU OD

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: driving without issue, reports occasional joint stiffness after long hours. cognition: Mini-Cog 3/5 (recall 2, clock draw abnormal) – positive screen, plan for full MoCA. falls: 1 fall in past year (slipped on wet floor, no injury), gait cautious, TUG 13 seconds (≥12) – raised fall risk, advise strength training and non‑slip footwear. medicines: 6 regular – polypharmacy, Beers review scheduled. mood: GAD‑7 10 (moderate anxiety), reports improved sleep after escitalopram increase. carers: daughter assists with grocery shopping. goals: "I want to stay steady on my feet and avoid another fall."
